instructions: Introducing Contest-Winning Annual Recipes 2011, where you'll find the "best of the best" recipes in one gorgeous, hardcover collection. You'll love the variety-and the Grand Prize flavors! You'll find snacks and beverages; salads, soups and sandwiches; breakfast dishes; main courses; sides, breads and rolls - plus a huge variety of delectable desserts. Every single dish was a prize winner in Taste of Home or one of its sister magazines. That's the best from five different publications, all in one place!
